name: library-manifest
body: Library manifest (the resolved library's `library.yaml`; `templates/library.yaml` for a local library): name identifier, optional description, required format version 1, plus the optional named definitions `groups:` (named accept-lists), `field_sets:` (named field groups) and `types:` (named field types) (named-definition), all part of format 1 (domain.constraint.library-manifest-format-stable). Identity for git-based sharing.
